description: turbo's plugin hooks. Before a Bash git commit in a TypeScript project, tsc --noEmit must pass (type-stripping is not type-checking). Before a .ts or .tsx write, block a module-level Map or Set cache under app/api/** (it leaks state between requests on serverless hosts) and a defaulted Zod schema reused for PATCH (it resets omitted fields). The gate log goes to a temp file, never into your project.
